A real Atlantan.  His ways became our own!  Love the guy


Web Barr (@WebBarr)

Bought the team in ‘76 because if he hadn’t they would’ve been shipped somewhere else! 

Got suspended by MLB and delta personally flew Atlantans to nyc to protest his suspension for “tampering” free agency aka drunk friendly banter at a World Series rainout party!

One of a kind



— https://nitter.net/WebBarr/status/2052414149905260871#m

Man U Gotta Love This Guy! He got in to trouble in the best ways possible 🤣🤣🤣🤣🤣 He Put On For The City! #Atlanta


Mike Vorkunov (@MikeVorkunov)

Ted Turner once jumped on the mic as the public broadcaster during a Hawks game — while he owned the Hawks — for the final 2:29 of a close game so he could cheer the team on over the public announce system in Atlanta. That got him a stern warning from the NBA the next day.





— https://nitter.net/MikeVorkunov/status/2052184020167827539#m

The Minister with some wisdom.  

instagram.com/reel/DX2G-gZs7…

And #TheSWAGshop in State Farm Arena is the Only Arena with a Barber shop and VIP view!










Reggie Chatman Jr. (@ReggieChatman)

I’m choosing to assume the ATL is the only airport in the country with a full on barber shop like this. What a city.





— https://nitter.net/ReggieChatman/status/2052393879064719719#m

MugenLord (@MugenLord)

Wow, I found my senior high school photo of my Business Teacher and me, Ms. Lu, back in 2005. She shaped me into the person I am today. She was so hard on me, and I didn't get it at the time. 

 I remember the time she gave me an after-school detention for scoring an 85 on my Accounting test. The rule for this exam was that if you scored below 70, you would receive detention. As no surprise, the 8 Asian students in our class s

The OG's campaign brought some amazing folks into my life


Ginger in GA 🚩🚱☢️ (@GingerInGA00)

Love this shout out Mike. So many great people united from Bernie 2016.



— https://nitter.net/GingerInGA00/status/2052366828182110560#m

They really do!  If u ever stuck on Atlanta's west side during those hours the #BankheadSeaFood does too! Come thru




EJDubya (@MsEbbieW)

Tom Dick and Hanks on Main Street in College Park has a nice Happy Hour.





— https://nitter.net/MsEbbieW/status/2052137257776144579#m

My Friend Ben of Ben is Jerry's is fighting a battle to get the company back to keep it true to the founding principles of being socially conscious.  I implore all to read and Join Ben & Jerry in their Fight!

fortune.com/2026/05/07/ben-j…

Here he is on #ConversateWithKillerMike piped.video/9lXMfGLYoG8?si=4N9Y…

@theswagshopedgewood has always been about more than cuts — it’s about community. Atlanta helped us establish roots, and now we’re honoring those same values as we grow. Big love to @Square for being part of the journey. #ad

I woke up with ‘Mania on my Mind. This beat is so cold I had to kill it. Don’t trip Cody, minor setback for a major comeback and congrats to Jey for getting his first World Title! Inspired By Old Atlanta & TBS! #wrestling #codyrhodes #jeyuso #rap #atlanta
Had to get bro right before his show in the A tomorrow @Tommy Richman
